1339-6495-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-6495-7920.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1531-1981-2034-2415.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2292-6854--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2292-6854--5--195.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Host of the Hereafter trigger.
Resolve Host of the Hereafter's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

2021-2060-5902-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

6723-6965-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
6723-6965-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
6723-6965-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

4559-4779-7096-7306.easyPrerequisites: You've had two or more lands enter this turn.
4559-4779-7096-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-4779-7096-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

104-560-5086-5183-5231.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
104-560-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

3912-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Khalni Garden.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Khalni Garden.
When Khalni Garden dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Khalni Garden enters, it triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

539-5256-7035.description:
Cast Earthbending Student by paying its mana cost
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Earthbending Student
When Earthbending Student dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Earthbending Student enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

874-1661-4195-4574.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1661-4195-4574.description:
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Delif's Cone from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1003-5220-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3094-3649-5277.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3094-3649-5277.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Lithoform Engine's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Lithoform Engine triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

2760-3108-4890.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Dack's Duplicate.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Dack's Duplicate by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

593-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Mogg Maniac.

1115-1563-2457-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1537-1785-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Zealous Conscripts.
1537-1785-5003.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, adding an amount of {B} equal to Zealous Conscripts's mana value.
When Zealous Conscripts dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.

4869-5436-6092.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
4869-5436-6092.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Glint-Horn Buccaneer triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

575-1207-5226.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Lithatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1170-3821-6063.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
1170-3821-6063.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Viscerid Armor by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Viscerid Armor spell.
Activate Viscerid Armor by paying {1}{U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3076-4474-4639-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.

Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sleep-Cursed Faerie triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

262-1242-2744.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness, and has a power of two or greater.
262-1242-2744.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating at least two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enters the battlefield, Cathars' Crusade trigger that many times, putting that many +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

957-3742-4477.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
957-3742-4477.description:
Cast Time Stretch, taking an extra two turns after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is tapped and attacking.
Greenwarden of Murasa enters, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1671-2174-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
1671-2174-4222.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

2882-4675-4694-4708.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4675-4694-4708.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Dark Sphere enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
